name: Camp Saw Mill
description_short: Day camp for young children at the Saw Mill Club in Mount Kisco, from a 3 year old group through 5th grade, with daily swim instruction in an outdoor pool reserved for campers, group tennis, playgrounds, crafts and special events. Half and full days, 3 to 5 days a week, minimum two weeks.
swim_waterfront_notes: Outdoor pool reserved for campers with daily assisted swim instruction, plus a kiddie pool.
refund_policy_summary: Camp fees, less the $400 non-refundable deposit and the 2.95% processing fee, are refunded only for withdrawals before May 15, 2026; no refunds or make ups after that.
notes: Non-member weekly prices: full day 8:45 to 3:00 $695 (5 days), $630 (4 days), $575 (3 days); half day 8:45 to 12:00 $575, $515, $450; mixed full and half day weeks $635 and $655. Club members pay $640 full day and $495 half day for 5 days. Minimum two weeks, 3 to 5 days a week. A $400 non-refundable deposit at registration goes toward the fee; balance due April 1 or in three payments. 10% off before February 15; 5% sibling discount. The worksheet also adds a $25 Brightwheel app fee and a 2.95% processing fee. Summer Tot Time (ages 1 to 2, mornings) is a separate program.
